title: W023-- Northwoods National Cemetery Office Trailer Lease
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > NATIONAL CEMETERY ADMIN (36C786)
description:
1. Subcontracting and Equipment Leasing
*** is considering an approach in which we would serve as the prime contractor, managing contract administration, quality assurance, government coordination, and supplier performance. We would engage an established equipment rental company to provide the office trailer, delivery, installation, maintenance, and eventual removal.
Would this arrangement be acceptable under the solicitation? Additionally, could you clarify which limitations on subcontracting, if any, would apply to this equipment leasing arrangement?
Quoters are strongly encouraged to demonstrate their own relevant experience and capabilities. Reliance on subcontractor experience/ certifications/ licensing to meet these requirements is discouraged and may not be considered sufficient in the evaluation of proposals. Preference will be given to proposals wherein the prime contractor clearly illustrates its direct experience and ability to successfully perform the required work without significant dependence on subcontractor s past performance.
FAR 52.219-14 Limitations on subcontracting applies and will be added to awarded contract.

2. Set-Aside and Evaluation Structure
The solicitation identifies a total small-business set-aside and establishes a tiered evaluation beginning with SDVOSBs.
Can you confirm that SBA-certified SDVOSBs will receive first consideration under the stated evaluation process?

Tiered Evaluation

The Government will evaluate quotations using a tiered comparative analysis approach. Quotations will first be considered within the highest priority socioeconomic tier identified in this solicitation. Within that tier, the Government will evaluate technical acceptability, past performance, and price in accordance with the stated evaluation criteria and will make a comparative assessment to determine whether award can be made at that level. If award cannot be made within that tier, the Government may proceed to the next tier and repeat the process. This approach preserves the tiered evaluation structure while allowing the Government to compare quotations within the applicable tier to determine the quotation that represents the best value. If the Government is unable to make an award after evaluating all applicable tiers, the Government reserves the right to cancel the solicitation, amend the solicitation, or resolicit as action determined to be in the best interest of the Government.

This requirement will be evaluated using a tiered approach in accordance with VAAR 815.101-370

SDVOSB concerns
VOSB concerns
Small Business concerns (HUBZone, 8(a), EDWOSB, and WOSB)
Other Small Business concerns that are not otherwise included in the above categories

3. Past Performance Requirements
Volume III requests three comparable past performance references but permits offerors with fewer references to explain their available experience.
As a newly established SDVOSB, *** does not yet have three comparable contracts performed under its own name. Would relevant experience from our proposed equipment supplier be considered alongside ***'s management experience, provided we clearly identify each party's role?
Quoters are strongly encouraged to demonstrate their own relevant experience and capabilities. Reliance on subcontractor experience/ certifications/ licensing to meet these requirements is discouraged and may not be considered sufficient in the evaluation of proposals. Preference will be given to proposals wherein the prime contractor clearly illustrates its direct experience and ability to successfully perform the required work without significant dependence on subcontractor s past performance.

4. Period of Performance
The solicitation identifies an anticipated performance period of January 1 through December 31, 2027, while the pricing schedule references December 14, 2026 through December 13, 2027.
Could you confirm the intended period of performance and whether the 30-day delivery requirement begins upon issuance of the Notice to Proceed?
The anticipated Period of performance is 1/1/202-13/31/2027, however it may change pending installation of electrical.
The Contractor shall provide a temporary office Trailer/Structure within 30 days of NTP (Notice to proceed) for a period of 12 months as well as all transportation, labor, parts, and materials to deliver, setup, secure, dismantle and remove at the end of the lease.
